kdump_path.description: Absolute path to the directory where kdump crash dumps are stored.

timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for kdump operations to complete before timing out.

retry.description: Number of times to retry the kdump fencing operation before reporting failure.

target.description: Hostname or IP address of the target node to be fenced using kdump.

extra_options.description: Additional command-line options to pass to fence_kdump (e.g., `--verbose`, `--force`).

items.description: A single fence_kdump option or flag.
